text: Maven build command for this project: `mvn package` → produces target/SnakeGame.jar with Main as entry point
Most important first modernization step for Snake: GitHub Actions CI (Phase 1), depends on Maven PR#1 being merged first
Snake color palette: bg #0F0F23, snake head #00FF87, snake body #00C9A7, food #FF6B6B, accent #4ECCA3, HUD bar #0A0A1A
